Avoid using `localeCompare` for sorting as it is locale-sensitive and can introduce discrepancies across different runtime environments. Use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison instead.

```suggestion
    blocker_reason_counts: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(blockerCounts).sort(([left], [right]) => (left < right ? -1 : left > right ? 1 : 0))),
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Avoid using Intl.Collator with an undefined locale for sorting, as it can introduce locale-sensitive discrepancies across different runtime environments. Instead, use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison to ensure locale-independent, deterministic ordering.
</details>

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The `rows` array in the generated manifest should be strictly ordered lexicographically by its ID field (`precise_crop_source_map_row_id`) using strict byte-order comparison.

```javascript
  const rows = [];

  for (const candidateEntry of candidateRows) {
    const sourceMapId = candidateEntry.row.precise_crop_source_map_row_id;
    rows.push(await buildQaRow({
      root,
      paths,
      candidateEntry,
      cropEntries: cropRowsBySourceMapId.get(sourceMapId) ?? [],
      manualEntries: manualRowsBySourceMapId.get(sourceMapId) ?? [],
      sourceMapEntry: sourceMapBySourceMapId.get(sourceMapId) ?? null,
      thresholds,
    }));
  }

  const sortedRows = sortByIdByteOrder(rows, 'precise_crop_source_map_row_id');

  const manifest = {
    schema_version: 'figureasset_wave1_crop_completeness_qa.v1',
    generated_at: generatedAt,
    generated_by: SCRIPT_PATH,
    issue: ISSUE_NUMBER,
    parent_issue: PARENT_ISSUE_NUMBER,
    depends_on_issue: DEPENDS_ON_ISSUE,
    chain: CHAIN_ID,
    subject_code: '9709',
    objective: 'Run visual completeness QA for Wave 1 crop artifacts and separate accepted crops from review/manual-crop cases.',
    boundary: {
      visual_qa_only: true,
      visual_qa_acceptance_is_not_rights_or_display_permission: true,
      external_vlm_calls_performed: 0,
      existing_vlm_signals_only: true,
      no_rights_approval_claimed: true,
      no_student_display_eligibility_claimed: true,
      no_source_visual_receipt_approved_claimed: true,
      no_method_map_truth_claimed: true,
      no_supabase_mutation: true,
      no_storage_upload: true,
      no_http_write_probe: true,
    },
    source_artifacts: sourceArtifactReceipts(root, paths),
    source_inputs: {
      candidate_bbox_proposals_path: paths.candidateBboxIn,
      precise_source_crops_path: paths.preciseCropsIn,
      precise_crop_source_map_path: paths.sourceMapIn,
    },
    qa_thresholds: thresholds,
    summary: null,
    rows: sortedRows,
  };
  manifest.summary = buildSummary(sortedRows, inputs.preciseCrops ?? {});
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure generated JSON arrays are strictly ordered by their ID fields (e.g., using a helper like sortByIdByteOrder) to prevent diff churn, and update corresponding test expectations to match this sorted order.
</details>
